Unique Research · Capital monthly · June 19, 2024

May 2024 AIGC financing — global overview, China vs. overseas, active investors, and secondary-market color. Charts image-only — attach on ingest.

01 · May snapshot

  • Global AIGC financing in May: ¥14.3B, +346.9% vs April
  • Largest single check: Mistral AI $600M (~¥4.265B) — French LLM lab founded May 2023; CEO Arthur Mensch aims past Silicon Valley leaders
  • China highlight: AI education Jingzhunxue (精准学) — ¥200M equity from Alibaba; exam-gene knowledge graphs + personalized teaching
  • Since 2022, LLM firms have raised trillions of RMB cumulatively; OpenAI alone >¥70B raised / >¥200B valuation cited; Moonshot (月之暗面) >¥7.2B with another round rumored (China Securities Journal)

Overseas May: angels active in early rounds (MavenAGI, Laws of Motion, Malted AI). Five companies at $100M+ USD: Mistral AI, DeepL, H (ex-Holistic AI) — $220M seed from DeepMind alumni / CEO Charles Kantor (ex-Stanford) building “frontier action models” for worker productivity — Weka.IO, Suno AI.

China May: 87 institutions invested; Hong Kong X Tech Fund and MiraclePlus each twice, others once. 50 AIGC companies funded; 10 at ¥100M+ (Jingzhunxue, Yuanting, Youlu Robot, Saifu Gene, Lianxin Digital, Yizhu Tech, Chaoxing Future, Zunshi Tech, etc.); 24 at ¥10M+.

02–04 · YTD through May

  • 2024 YTD global AIGC financing ~¥78.4B, −3.3% vs prior-year ¥81.1B — but far more deals (263 vs 50)
  • By country amount: U.S. ¥40.603B / 70 deals (~48% of China’s deal count); China ¥17.153B / 145 deals (most deals); Canada ¥4.189B / 3; UK ¥2.648B / 10; Korea ¥1.525B / 3
  • China active investors (Jan–May): MiraclePlus 12 deals; Alibaba 4; six firms at 3 (Baidu Ventures, iFlytek, GSR, Ameba, Shunxi, etc.); 19 names at 2
  • China: 131 companies financed YTD; 27 at ¥100M+; Moonshot $1B largest, MiniMax $600M second. Feb amount led months at ¥8.249B on Moonshot disclosure; May jumped to ~2× 2024 monthly average
  • Overseas active LPs: General Catalyst 5; Lightspeed / NEA / a16z 4; eight firms incl. NVIDIA, Sequoia, Index at 3. Amazon ~¥2B leading by amount; 49 overseas firms put ≥¥1B YTD. Overseas projects Jan–May ~¥61.3B

05 · Secondary market

East Money AIGC concept index (May 31): 1,248.19, −9.22% MoM; turnover ¥549B; turnover ratio 47.77%. (CN also notes unrelated fashion-design listing color in source — charts carry board detail.)

06 · Disclaimer

For research reference; not investment advice. Credit Unique Research when citing.

— END —
